Once per round, when you're targeted by a ranged attack or subjected to an effect that lets you make a Dexterity save, and cover exists within 10 feet of you, you can move up to 10 feet at no action cost, provided you end that movement in cover.

You can use this feature twice, gaining one more use at each of 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and you regain all uses on finishing a long rest.
